  Exam Date & Time: 15-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Advanced Software Engineering [IT_4417]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Analyze the Cleanroom Software Engineering process. How does it differ from  
  conventional testing strategies in ensuring defect prevention and reliability?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Evaluate the strengths and limitations of formal specification languages in modeling  
  concurrent systems. Discuss their impact on scalability and correctness.                      (5)  
  
  2)           Analyze a hypothetical failure scenario in an avionics autopilot system. Identify safety-  
  critical components, potential failure modes, and propose how a safety case structure  
  (5)  
  (claims, arguments, and evidence) can be developed.  
  A)  
  B)      Critique the effectiveness of safety cases in certifying safety-critical systems such as  
  automotive braking or flight control. Support your evaluation with suitable industry          (5)  
  examples.  
  
  3)           Compare the lifecycle activities of safety-critical systems with those of conventional  
  software systems. What unique verification, validation, and certification challenges arise  
  (5)  
  in safety-critical development?  
  A)  
  B)      Evaluate the suitability of component composition techniques in dynamic runtime  
  environments. Discuss how interface contracts and dependency management affect                (5)  
  adaptability and performance.  
  
  4)           Evaluate the effectiveness of Software Product Lines in reducing development cost and  
  time-to-market. Discuss factors affecting their industrial adoption.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain how Software Product Lines enable systematic reuse across multiple  
  applications. Analyze how core asset management supports flexibility and scalability.         (5)  
  
  5)           Evaluate the contribution of timing analysis in ensuring predictability and schedulability  
  of real-time applications. Illustrate with an example from an embedded control system  
  (5)  
  A)
